title: THE TEAM STRIP IS NOT BEHIND THE HOW TO PLAY CARD
why: His order of 2026-10-18: there seem to be a lot of inconsistencies between p1 and p2 games, please coordinate them better. A party window that waits while a run is live (player 2, or a benched player 1) draws JOIN YOUR TEAM, TEAM SCORE as a strip 28.5 percent from the bottom. The how to play card now reaches down to 84 percent of the screen, so the strip was drawn behind its rows and read faintly through the card. With a page or the run over card up it now sits on the bottom margin under the card.
now: While a party run is live the waiting window shows Join your team on the bottom edge under the how to play card, not behind its rows.
